verdict.rationale: Vanta's Questionnaire Automation product explicitly generates draft answers from a company's security knowledge base and prior questionnaires, with human review before submission ('Vanta combs through your knowledge base... to generate responses'; 'Vanta takes care of the heavy lifting—so all you need to do is review, approve, and submit'), plus Trust Center and AI Agent features that draft policies and complete questionnaires. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of answer accuracy and reviewer workflow beyond vendor marketing copy, and detail on how it sources 'actual controls' data versus just prior answers.
